title: RunManifest
description: A run manifest: the machine-readable record of one complete newsroom pipeline run (v0.5 persistence contract). A run is reproducible and inspectable: it records the workspace, topic, source mode, profile and model metadata, a redacted configuration snapshot, the full stage lifecycle with attempt history, and every artifact produced. The manifest is the durable record of the run; workspace files are derived, reproducible artifacts. Cross-field consistency rules (status vs. stage states, outcome vs. status, timestamps) are enforced by internal/run and documented in docs/contracts-v0.5.md.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the run manifest schema. Consumers accept only a known major version; within a major, unknown minor/patch fields are ignored.

id.description: Stable run identifier: run-<compact started_at>-<12-hex digest of workspace name, topic, and started_at>.

name.description: Workspace name; also its directory name on disk.

path.description: Optional directory path where this workspace lives.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the run. pending is the initial state, running is active, and the rest are terminal.

topic.description: The topic of the news output. Deterministic for identical inputs.

source_mode.description: How the pipeline got its sources: explicit URLs, runtime discovery, or a supplement of previously discovered sources.

hash.description: Optional content hash of the profile file, for reproducibility.

profile.description: The profile used for this run, when one applies.

values.description: Redacted configuration snapshot. Values that look like secrets are stored as the redaction placeholder, never the raw secret.

config.description: Configuration snapshot at the start of the run, with secret-like values redacted.

stages.description: The planned stages of this run, in pipeline order. A run may plan any subset of the canonical stages; stages not present were not planned.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced by the run. Stage outputs and metadata; never the raw source corpus. Referenced by path, not embedded.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings recorded during the run.

errors.description: Run-level error summaries (stage-level errors live on the attempt). Redacted; never contain secrets.

finished_at.description: Set when the run reaches a terminal status; null while in progress.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with up to nanosecond precision.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the model endpoint. Never includes credentials; values containing embedded credentials are redacted at construction.

modelMetadata.description: Model and endpoint metadata for the run. Identifies the model used without recording credentials.

skip_reason.description: Required when status is skipped; empty otherwise.

attempts.description: Chronological attempt history, numbered 1..N. Empty for pending and skipped stages.

error.description: Required when status is failed; only valid on failed attempts.

path.description: Relative path of the artifact on disk. Must not traverse outside the workspace.

outcome.description: Set once the run reaches a terminal status.

failed_stage.description: The stage whose failure caused the run to fail. Only set for failed runs.

result.description: Terminal result of the run. Empty while the run is in progress.
